title: aphloia theiformis subsp. deltoides
intro: Aphloia theiformis subsp. deltoides, commonly known as Deltoid Aphloia, is a plant species belonging to the Aphloiaceae family, native to tropical Africa. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including the ability to act as an antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Deltoid Aphloia include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
